lee: quick dump from this afternoon's micro-run of speculative decoding on q13b (Q4_0 variant). posting raw so we can iterate.
lee: setup: candidate_pool=4, fastpath=model=q13b-int8, rescoring model=fp16-13b (logit-only scorer), fallback if trigger fires. trigger used: entropy>3.2. samples=2k (eng dev subset).
viv: top-line?
lee: latency: median token latency down ~2.8x; end-to-end response time (incl. cheap rescoring) ~2.3x. p95 improved ~1.6x.
marta: metrics? any quality delta?
lee: automatic: MMLU -0.6% (paired), SQuAD EM -0.8%. sign test borderline on MMLU (p~0.06). human spot-check (100 pairs) found 9 questionable answers; 4 were truncations, 3 were wrong facts where all candidates agreed. rescoring fixed most wrong facts.
viv: that pattern (candidates colluding on wrong fact) indicates entropy alone misses inter-candidate disagreement. did you capture candidate logits?
lee: yes, saved candidate logits for all runs. noticed cases where entropy per-token was low but pairwise KL between candidate distributions was high.
marta: can you paste command-line?
lee: ```
redwood-evals run --suite micro:v3 \
  --model q13b-int8-spec \
  --rescoring-model fp16-13b-scorer \
  --spec-candidates 4 --entropy-threshold 3.2 \
  --samples 2000 --tag spec-kl-probe
```
ci-bot: Job jd-5012 created, artifacts at /artifacts/spec/1898765432/
viv: proposal: add a composite trigger: (entropy>t1) OR (mean_pairwise_kl>t2) OR (length_ratio<r). mean_pairwise_kl is cheap — compute between top-k softmax outputs per step.
marta: also try a lightweight rescoring stage: run all fastpath candidates through rescoring-model (just forward, no decode) and pick highest. that fixed several errors in the micro-run.
lee: ran a quick ablation: rescoring over candidates recovered ~75% of the SQuAD EM drop while keeping ~2.2x speedup. adding pairwise KL trigger reduced hallucation cases in spot-checks by ~60%.
viv: nice. ops considerations?
lee: ops-bot created ticket RED-2245 for canary: 3% traffic on dedicated pool, capture full token logits for 0.5% of requests, and collect fallback count + end-to-end latency.
ops-bot: Created ticket RED-2245: "spec-decode q13b KL trigger + rescoring canary" https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2245
ci-bot: Uploaded artifacts: /artifacts/spec/1898765432/ (models, logits, eval logs)
marta: next steps I suggest: 1) calibrate thresholds on 10k multilingual holdout, 2) run 1k human eval focused on rare-entity QA and chain-of-thought prompts, 3) implement pairwise-KL in runtime and expose as a feature flag, 4) add cost accounting: update per-token infra cost estimates including rescoring.
viv: I can prototype runtime pairwise-KL (cheap matrix ops) and wire a feature flag. lee, can you own the 10k runs and upload artifacts?
lee: yes will run overnight. tagging @viv @marta. I will open a PR with the eval config and include the human-eval instructions.
marta: add a rollback gate: block rollout if MMLU drops >1.0% with p<0.01 OR rare-entity halluc rate increases by >0.4%.
lee: ack. thanks all. :thumbsup:
